tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who works in the Office of Admissions and have noticed that the office printer frequently malfunctions. You want to report this problem to the university's IT department and suggest a solution. Write an email to the IT manager, Mr. Evans.
bullets: Describe the issues you are experiencing with the printer.
Explain how these issues are affecting your work.
Suggest a possible solution to the problem.
tasks.subject: Printer Malfunction Issues
